q: I don't think he will come to the party, ______?
explain: 主句是 I don't think 时，反意疑问句与从句保持一致，且否定转移后从句视为否定，附加部分用肯定 will he。

q: The doctor suggested that the patient ______ a good rest.
explain: suggest 表示建议时，其后宾语从句用虚拟语气 should do，should 可以省略，故用动词原形 have。

q: ______ the meeting was over, all the people left the hall.
explain: as soon as 表示一……就，从句用一般过去时主句也用一般过去时，时态一致。hardly 和 no sooner 位于句首需倒装且与过去完成时搭配，not until 也需倒装，均与题干语序时态不符。

q: — What did Mr Smith say? — He asked ______.
options: what the matter was with me
what was the matter wrong with me
explain: what was wrong with me 中 what 本身作主语，语序不变，间接引语中保持原语序，用陈述语序即可。

q: 句子「I don't know where does he come from.」语法正确。
explain: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序，疑问语序 where does he come from 错误，应为 where he comes from。

q: By the end of last month, we ______ about 2,000 English words.
explain: by the end of last month 指到过去某一时间为止已完成的动作，用过去完成时 had learned，这是与现在完成时混淆的易错点。

q: The little girl was made ______ the piano for two hours every day.
explain: make sb do 变被动语态时要还原 to，即 be made to do，故用 to practise，这是常见易错点。

q: — What about ______ shopping this weekend? — Good idea.
explain: What about 后接动名词 doing，表示……怎么样，用 going。

q: — Must I finish the work today? — No, you ______.
explain: 对 Must 开头的一般疑问句作否定回答用 needn't 或 don't have to，表示不必。mustn't 表示禁止，语气太强。

q: 句子「Not until midnight did he finish his homework.」语法正确。
explain: not until 位于句首时主句部分倒装，did he finish 为正确倒装形式，表示直到半夜他才完成作业。

q: He was ______ tired ______ he couldn't walk any further.
explain: so...that 引导结果状语从句，so 后接形容词 tired。such 后接名词短语，too...to 后接动词原形不能接句子。

q: The boy ______ is playing basketball on the playground is my brother.
explain: 先行词 the boy 指人，且在定语从句中作主语，用 who 引导。which 指物，whom 作宾语，whose 表所属。

q: — Shall we go to the park this afternoon? — ______ It's going to rain.
explain: 由后句天要下雨可知不赞成去公园，I'm afraid not 表示恐怕不行，委婉拒绝。Good idea 与语境矛盾。

q: It's your turn ______ the blackboard, Li Ming.
explain: It's one's turn to do sth 是固定句型，表示轮到某人做某事，用 to clean。

q: — Would you mind if I smoke here? — ______. You'd better not.
explain: 根据后句 You'd better not 可知说话人不希望对方吸烟，I'm afraid not 委婉表示不同意。Not at all 表示不介意，与语境矛盾。

q: — How long may I ______ the book? — For two weeks.
explain: how long 与延续性动词连用，borrow 和 lend 是短暂性动词，不能与时间段连用，应用 keep 表示借多久。

q: The nurse asked the boy ______ his temperature first.
explain: ask sb to do sth 表示让某人做某事，用动词不定式 to take 作宾语补足语。

q: 句子「He suggested me to go there by bus.」语法正确。
explain: suggest 不能用于 suggest sb to do sth 结构，可说 suggest doing 或 suggest that sb should do，应改为 He suggested going there by bus 或 He suggested that I go there by bus。

q: 句子「This is the book which I bought it yesterday.」语法正确。
explain: 定语从句中关系代词 which 已充当 bought 的宾语，it 重复多余，应删去 it。

q: 对话「—Would you please help me carry the box? —With pleasure.」表达得体。
explain: With pleasure 表示很乐意帮忙，是回答请求的常用礼貌用语，表达得体。

q: So far, great changes ______ place in our hometown.
explain: so far 是现在完成时的标志词，take place 无被动形式，用 have taken。

q: — Do you know ______? — Next Sunday.
explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，排除疑问语序的选项；答语 Next Sunday 指将来，从句用一般将来时 they will come。

q: 句子「I wish I can fly to the moon one day.」语法正确。
explain: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气，与现在事实相反用过去式，应为 I wish I could fly to the moon one day。

q: I heard someone ______ for help when I passed the river.
explain: hear sb doing 表示听见某人正在做某事，强调动作正在进行。hear sb do 表示听见全过程，此处路过时呼救正在进行，用 shouting。

q: Could you please ______ me your dictionary? Mine is lost.
explain: lend sb sth 表示把某物借给某人，此处请对方把字典借出给自己，用 lend。borrow 是从别人处借入，方向相反。

q: Why not ______ your teacher for help when you are in trouble?
explain: Why not 后接动词原形，表示为什么不……，用于提建议。

q: My father was too tired. He stopped ______ a rest after working for hours.
explain: stop to do 表示停下来去做另一件事，此处指停下工作去休息，用 to have。stop having a rest 表示停止休息，与语境相反。

q: Could you tell me ______ the nearest hospital is?
explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，where the nearest hospital is 语序正确。where is 是疑问语序，不能用于宾语从句。

q: Remember ______ off the lights when you leave the classroom.
explain: remember to do 表示记得要去做某事，事情还没做；remember doing 表示记得做过某事。离开教室时才要关灯，动作未发生，用 to turn。

q: The reason ______ he was late was ______ he missed the early bus.
explain: 先行词 reason 后接 why 引导的定语从句；表语从句用 that 引导，即 The reason why...is that... 是固定句型，不能用 because 替代 that。

q: We ______ the classroom already. It's clean now.
explain: already 是现在完成时的标志词，且后句说明现在的结果，用 have cleaned。

q: — What do you think of our new teacher? — ______
explain: What do you think of... 询问对某人的看法，回答应是评价性的，She is kind and patient 符合。其它选项是事实陈述非评价。

q: It is necessary that everyone ______ the rules of the school.
explain: It is necessary that 从句用虚拟语气 should do，should 可省略，故用动词原形 obey。这是易与陈述语气混淆的考点。

q: He prefers ______ at home rather than ______ out on such a cold day.
explain: prefer to do rather than do 是固定句型，表示宁愿做……而不愿做……，两空分别用 to stay 和 go。

q: The teacher told us to stop ______ and listen to her carefully.
explain: stop doing 表示停止正在做的事，stop to do 表示停下来去做另一件事。老师让学生停止讲话，用 stop talking。

q: 句子「Such fine weather is it that we all want to go out.」语法正确。
explain: such...that 句型中 such 位于句首时句子倒装，Such fine weather is it 语序正确，表示天气如此好以至于大家都想出去。

q: The teacher made the students ______ the text after class.
explain: make sb do sth 表示让某人做某事，用动词原形 recite。注意被动语态中才还原 to。

q: — I called you this time yesterday, but nobody answered. — Oh, I ______ a shower at that time.
explain: this time yesterday 和 at that time 都指过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was taking。

q: — I'm going to Hainan for my holiday. — ______
explain: 对方要去度假，应祝愿 Have a good time 玩得愉快。其余选项用于回应道歉或安慰，不合语境。

q: He spent two hours ______ his homework yesterday evening.
explain: spend time doing sth 是固定句型，表示花费时间做某事，用 doing。

q: It is high time that we ______ measures to protect the environment.
explain: It is high time that 从句用虚拟语气，谓语用一般过去式 took，表示早该做某事。这是常见考点。

q: This factory ______ in 1998 and has produced cars ever since.
explain: 工厂是被建造的，用被动语态；in 1998 是过去时间，用一般过去时的被动 was built。

q: The old man lives ______, but he never feels ______.
explain: live alone 表示独自居住，alone 作副词；feel lonely 表示感到孤独，lonely 是形容词，二者易混，前者强调客观独自，后者强调主观感受。

q: 句子「The film is worth seeing.」语法正确。
explain: be worth doing 是固定结构，用主动形式表示被动意义，seeing 用法正确。

q: 句子「I would rather stay at home than go out in the heavy rain.」语法正确。
explain: would rather do than do 是固定句型，表示宁愿做……而不愿做……，两个动词都用原形，句子结构正确。

q: 句子「It takes me half an hour do my homework every day.」语法正确。
explain: It takes sb some time to do sth 句型中要用动词不定式，应改为 to do my homework。

q: Our monitor is always ready ______ others.
explain: be ready to do 是固定搭配，表示乐意做某事、准备好做某事。

q: 对话「—I'm sorry to trouble you. —It doesn't matter.」表达得体。
explain: 回应道歉常用 It doesn't matter，表示没关系，是得体的日常交际用语。

q: He had hardly got to the station ______ the train left.
explain: hardly...when 是固定搭配，表示刚……就。no sooner 与 than 搭配，注意不要张冠李戴。

q: 句子「No sooner had I got home than it began to rain.」语法正确。
explain: no sooner...than 句型中，no sooner 位于句首主句用过去完成时并倒装，从句用一般过去时，本句结构和时态都正确。
